positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Backend engineer on Automation team, focusing on automating tasks for users in expense management software
• Designed and led execution of an integration with Uber for automatic receipt capture and roster syncing
• Built a service for working with generative AI APIs, including brainstorming and hacking use cases, building common functionality on top of external APIs, and providing guidance/support to engineers throughout the company who built on top of it

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full stack iOS engineer on Charitable Giving, within the Social Impact org
• Built out fundraising tools in FB Stories, including an interactive sticker and a search engine
• Helped bring standalone fundraisers to Instagram, including building out the main page and integrating into existing surfaces like Profile and Feed
• Ran experiments with millions of participants
• Worked across client/server between FB and IG using Python, PHP,
Objective-C, and GraphQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Collaborated on a cross team project to build a new transferrable student records feature
• Developed in the full stack: Python, Django, MySQL, React, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS etc.
• Built mechanisms for microservices to transfer data between one another

positions.title: Software Test Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Created automated Selenium tests using Python
• Developed a load test proof of concept using C 
• Built up a Tkinter GUI and connected it to command line tools

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•  Created data driven tests for scanners using C#
•  Built libraries to control GUIs
•  Investigated and developed ways to automate validation of imaging
features using image recognition
